description.value: A classic roadside motel sitting directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops, positioned as a natural rest stop for cyclists completing the Thompson River corridor stretch of the route. Ten of the rooms include full kitchenettes, and facilities include coin laundry, BBQ, and a 24-hour front desk. Small pets are permitted and the motel is fully non-smoking throughout.

address.value: 2505 East Trans Canada Highway, Kamloops, BC V2C 4A9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the motel is an active, operating property on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops. Phone, website URL, and address base number all match OSM, though the website adds 'East' to the street name. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or any cycling-specific services appears anywhere in the website content; Wi-Fi and coin laundry are explicitly confirmed.
concerns: OSM addr:street is 'Trans-Canada Highway' but website consistently shows 'East Trans Canada Highway' — address updated to website version; OSM tag may need correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel with active website, online reservation system, and consistent contact details. A practical overnight stop for Trans-Canada touring cyclists.

Laundry.detail: Coin laundry mentioned on front page; 'Laundry' and 'Ironing Service' listed under Services in the Facilities section

Wi-Fi.detail: Website states: 'Free wireless internet access available in public areas and all guest rooms.'
